title: RNASSTR v2: RNA sequence-secondary-structure pairs and model benchmark outputs
description: RNASSTR v2 provides structure-aware training, validation, and test partitions of RNA sequence-secondary-structure pairs, together with the model prediction and scoring files used to evaluate published SincFold, RNASSTR-retrained SincFold, Lyra-TransPred, and RNAfold in the accompanying manuscript.
